title: Zach Top Shares Why Competing Against Chris Stapleton at the CMAs Feels So Special

 Music Zach Top Shares Why Competing Against Chris Stapleton at the CMAs Feels So Special
 Zach Top is heading into the 60th Annual CMA Awards with plenty to celebrate. Among his fellow nominees in the highly competitive Male Vocalist of the Year category is none…
 Yvette Dela Cruz 
 Published Nov 17, 2026 11:33 AM EST Photo by Jason Kempin/Getty Images Share this story Zach Top is heading into the 60th Annual CMA Awards with plenty to celebrate. Among his fellow nominees in the highly competitive Male Vocalist of the Year category is none other than Chris Stapleton, an artist Top deeply admires. 
 In a recent interview with Country Now , Top reflected on the surreal experience of competing alongside Stapleton, revealing how much he enjoyed touring with the country superstar earlier this year. He also shared his excitement about his Album of the Year nomination and teased a special surprise for fans watching the upcoming awards ceremony. 
 Zach Top Calls Touring With Chris Stapleton a Bucket-List Moment 
 Sharing a CMA Awards category with one of his musical heroes is already a significant milestone for Top. However, the opportunity to tour with Stapleton earlier this year made the experience even more meaningful. 
 Top opened select dates for the Grammy-winning singer, giving him the chance to watch Stapleton perform night after night from the side of the stage. 
 "We got to tour a little bit with Chris Stapleton this year, which was a bucket list thing for me," Top told Country Now . 
 The rising country star didn't hold back when discussing his admiration for Stapleton, describing him as one of his favorite artists and a generational talent. He also praised Stapleton's songwriting abilities, powerful vocals, and remarkable stage presence. 
 For Top, watching Stapleton perform every night offered a closer look at what makes the singer such a compelling live performer. 
 'He Doesn't Even Have to Move a Muscle' 
 While some performers rely on elaborate stage productions and constant movement to command an audience, Stapleton takes a different approach. 
 According to Top, the singer's performances revolve entirely around the music. With nothing more than his guitar and unmistakable voice, Stapleton effortlessly keeps audiences captivated. 
 "His show is so cool to me. It is so all about the music. He just stands there and he plays the guitar and he sings and people cannot get enough," Top explained. 
 Top summed up his admiration with a simple but heartfelt statement: "He's absolutely incredible. I love that dude." That admiration makes sharing the Male Vocalist of the Year category with Stapleton particularly special. 
 Major Recognition for 'Ain't In It For My Health' 
 Beyond his Male Vocalist of the Year nomination, Top also earned a spot in the Album of the Year category for his sophomore album,  Ain't In It For My Health . 
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Spotify (@spotify) 
 The recognition means a lot to the singer, especially considering the number of outstanding country albums released each year. 
 Top described the nomination as a meaningful stamp of approval from the country music community. "To have enough folks think that yours was one of the best that you wind up in that category, let alone the possibility of winning that award…that's a really, really cool stamp of approval," he shared. 
 The 60th Annual CMA Awards will take place on Wednesday, November 18, airing live at 8 p.m. ET/7 p.m. CT on ABC and Disney+. Viewers can also stream the broadcast on Hulu the following day.
